source: 683 Dance
target: 683 Saltatio

source: Hearing her companion’s words, the woman in the light-colored dress’s expression turned solemn.
target: Audivit verba comitis, et vultus feminae in veste clara induta in sollemnite versa est.

source: “I had a similar feeling, but it wasn’t as specific as yours.”
target: “Sensivi similem affectum, sed non ita specificum quam tuum.”

source: The man in the dark-gray suit visibly calmed down and glanced back over his shoulder.
target: Vir in vestitu cinereo obscuro visibiliter se tranquillavit atque retrospexit super humerum.

source: “Let’s hurry to our destination. There seem to be many abnormalities beyond our grasp here.”
target: “Festinemus ad metam nostram. Hic videntur esse multa insolita extra nostram comprehensionem.”

source: The woman in the light-colored dress gave a single nod of acknowledgment.
target: Femina in veste clara unico annuendo agnitionem manifestavit.

source: After ascertaining their direction, they quickened their pace and swiftly left the intersection behind them.
target: Postquam viam suam cognovissent, celeritatem auguerunt atque per crucem viarum citissime reliquerunt.

source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: Lumian, wearing a golden straw hat, led Amandina, Robert, and the others back to the small square from the side of Saint-Sien Cathedral.
target: Lumian, pileum stramineum aureum gestans, Amandinam, Robertum, et ceteros ab latere Sanctae Sien Cathedralis ad parvum forum duxit.

source: At that moment, Camus spotted figures lingering in the cemetery on the other side.
target: Ad illud tempus, Camus figuras in coemeterio in altera parte morantes conspexit.

source: Startled, he focused his gaze and realized they were pale‑white bones hung with tattered cloths and humanoid phantoms made of fine ashes.
target: Stupefactus, oculos intendit et conscivit eos esse ossa pallide alba, vestimentis laceratis suspensa, atque phantasmata humanoides ex tenuis cineribus facta.

source: Many upright tombstones lay on the ground, and many graves had clearly suffered damage.
target: Multae lapides sepulcrales erecti in terra iacebant, et multa sepulcra manifeste laesa erant.

source: “The awakened dead?” Camus furrowed his brow and asked Amandina. “The Dream Festival can also awaken bones and ashes?”
target: “Mortui excitati?” Camus supercilia contraxit et Amandinae quaesivit. “Festum Somniorum etiam ossa et cineres excitare potest?”

source: Regardless of life or death, they had to celebrate the Dream Festival?
target: Sive vivi sive mortui, Festum Somniorum celebrandum esse videbatur?

source: Amandina nodded nimbly.
target: Amandina vivaciter annuit.

source: “Isn’t that normal? Robert obtained superpowers from the Corpse Collector pathway during the Dream Festival. That’s the Death domain, so the Dream Festival itself has such—uh, characteristics.”
target: “Nonne id commune est? Robertus in Festo Somniorum per iter Collectoris Cadaverum potentias supernaturales adeptus est. Id est regnum Mortis, itaque Festum Somniorum ipsa talia—eh, proprietates—habet.”

source: Amandina was secretly pleased that her knowledge surpassed that of a seasoned patrol team member in this area.
target: Amandina tacite laetabatur quod scientia eius praestaret illius periti custodis huius regionis.

source: She consoled Camus, “Don’t worry. The bones and shadows in the cemetery are very peaceful. They’re completely different from the humans at the Dream Festival. As long as you don’t approach them, they won’t attack you. They’ll only wander around their graves.”
target: Amandina Camum consolata dixit: “Noli timere. Ossa et umbrae in coemeterio valde tranquillae sunt. Ab hominibus in Festo Somniorum prorsus diffluunt. Dummodo non illos appropinques, te non oppugnabunt; solum circa sepulcra sua errabunt.”

source: “Of course they’re peaceful,” Lumian, who was leading the way, chuckled. “They usually don’t have emotions or desires to suppress. They won’t form an intense projection in this dream.”
target: “Certe tranquilli sunt,” risit Lumian, viam ducens. “Saepe affectus nec cupiditates habent; non efficiunt potentem praesentiam in hoc somnio.”

source: The dead were emotionless!
target: Mortui erant sine affectu!

source: Of course, excluding those who had perished with resentment and hatred, those buried in Saint-Sien Cathedral’s cemetery must have undergone purification.
target: Certe, excepto illis qui cum rancore et odio perierunt, qui in coemeterio Sanctae Sien Cathedralis sepulti sunt, purgationem subisse oportuisse censetur.

source: “That’s not funny.” Amandina wanted to console her silent fiancé, but she felt she didn’t have the right after witnessing his indecency and being complicit in killing his lover.
target: “Hoc non iocum est.” Amandina tacitum sponsum consolari cupivit, sed sensit se ius deesse, postquam eius turpitates conspexit et in scelere amantis interfectio particeps fuit.

source: Everything she said seemed hypocritical, so she had no choice but to speak to Louis Berry instead.
target: Omnia quae dixerat hypocrita videbantur; ideo non potuit nisi ad Ludovicum Berry loqui.

source: She muttered inwardly, Hmph, as his fiancée notarized in the cathedral, it’s my legitimate right to punish my fiancé’s lover.
target: Intime submurmuravit: “Hem, cum sponsa eius in cathedral notarata sit, mihi ius legitimum est amantem sponsi mei puniendum.”

source: It’s a little overboard, but in the face of the blasphemer, the demon who preyed on a minor, being a little overboard is a revelation from God!
target: Parum nimis, sed coram blasphemante et daemonio, qui parvulo nocuit, hoc nimis esse revelatio Dei censetur!

source: The more she thought about it, the more right she felt.
target: Quo magis id meditata est, eo magis se iustum sensit.

source: Lumian walked swiftly along the shadows beside the road.
target: Lumian celeriter secum ambulavit per umbras iuxta viam.

source: After some thought, he said, “Will those killed during the Dream Festival awaken and become undead?”
target: Post aliquod meditandum, dixit: “Eritne illi qui in Festo Somniorum interfecti sunt excitati atque quasi mortui iterum vivi facti?”

source: “Yes, but it takes a long time. I’ve only encountered them near the end of the Dream Festival. They’re cold and aggressive,” Amandina recalled.
target: “Ita, sed multum temporis requirit.” Eos solum prope finem Festi Somniorum convenisse meminit. “Frigidi et pugnaces sunt,” inquit Amandina.

source: Seizing the opportunity, Rhea asked, “When will the Dream Festival end?”
target: Occasio captus, Rhea rogavit: “Quando finietur Festum Somniorum?”

source: Amandina replied with a smile, “Haven’t you noticed? The wall clocks and pocket watches are still ticking. The Dream Festival ends just before dawn.”
target: Amandina subrisu respondit: “Nonne animadvertistis? Horologia muraria et horologia portabilia adhuc tictitant. Festum Somniorum paulo ante auroram finitur.”

source: “Is there a way to leave the Dream Festival early?” Lugano was concerned over this question.
target: “Estne via Festum Somniorum mature relinquendi?” Lugano de hac quaestione sollicitus erat.

source: Amandina glanced at Robert, who remained silent.
target: Amandina Roberto intuebatur, qui silent inerat.

source: “There’s no way. We can usually escape by sleeping in Twanaku’s house and being stimulated at the edge of the dream. Once the Dream Festival begins, we can only wait for it to end naturally.”
target: “Nulla via est. Saepe evadere possumus, dormientes in domo Twanaku et excitati in margine somnii. Quondam Festum Somniorum coeptum est, solum exspectare eum naturaliter finiri possumus.”

source: Lugano shut his mouth in disappointment and unconsciously took two steps closer to Lumian.
target: Lugano os in destituenda clauserunt et inconscius duos passus propius ad Luminum fecit.

source: Camus observed Amandina’s brisk strides and fell silent for a few seconds before asking, “Aren’t you going back to Palm Manor to protect your parents? Aren’t you worried they’ll die during the Dream Festival?”
target: Camus Amandinae celeres gressus animadvertit et paucis momentis siluit antequam rogavit: “Nonne ad Palm Manor redeas ut parentes tuos protegas? Nonne sollicita es ne parentes tui in Festo Somniorum moriantur?”

source: Amandina pursed her lips and said with a complicated smile, “During last year’s Dream Festival, I rushed back to protect them. I didn’t expect them to have a ‘happy’ time and not be in any danger…”
target: Amandina labra contraxit et subrisu implicato dixit: “Durante Festo Somniorum anni praeteriti, celeriter redii ut eos protegerem. Nondum exspectavi eos tempus ‘felicem’ agere nec in quacumque periculo versari…”

source: “My mother prefers the lowest‑class, filthiest, yet relatively muscular slaves to do the deed while she curses them. I don’t know what mental issues that stems from or which areas that indulges, but this way, the male slaves definitely won’t kill her. Instead, her jealous lady’s maids and female slaves who get too close will be subdued and forced to join if they approach.”
target: “Mater mea praeoptat ut servi ex classe infima, spurcissimi, sed aliquantulum musculosi rem efficiant, dum eos maledicit. Nescio ex quibus perturbationibus mentis hoc oritur aut quibus inclinationibus se indulgat; sed hoc modo, servi masculi certe eam non occiderunt. Immo, ancillae zelantes dominae suae atque servi feminae, qui nimis accedant, subibuntur et coacti erunt ut se coniungant.”

source: “As for my father, he relied on his career in the Southern Continent to obtain the Legion of Honor medal. When awake, he’s always afraid of attacks and slave riots. He built several bunkers in the manor and stockpiled food and weapons. He constantly practices combat, shooting, and military tactics. Even during the Dream Festival, it would be very difficult for the servants and slaves to take him down. They’d have to break through layers of defenses until he retreats to a bunker.”
target: “Quod ad patrem meum attinet, in curriculo suo in Continente Meridionali confisus est ut medalliam Legionis Honoris obtineret. Cum vigilat, semper impetum et seditionem servorum timebat. In manerio plura castra subterranea aedificavit et cibum armaque condidit. Cotidie in pugna, telis iaciendis, et consiliis militaribus exerceret. Etiam in Festo Somniorum, a servis et ministris eum deponere valde difficile esset. Opus esset ut per stratas defensionum rupirent, donec in castra subterranea se recipiat.”

source: “Unless a Beyonder deliberately goes after them, they’ll be very safe. If I stayed to protect them, it might be more dangerous—I mean I’m more dangerous. I might not tolerate the ‘love’ of those men or the jealousy of those women. I don’t wish to kill too many people either.”
target: “Nisi Beyonder eos deliberatis persequeretur, valde tuti erunt. Si manerem ut eos protegerem, forsitan periculosior fierem—scilicet, ipse periculosior sum. Fortasse non perferrem ‘amorem’ illorum virorum aut zelam illorum feminarum. Ego quoque nolo nimis multos interficere.”

source: Could it be that she’s more afraid of sensing the malice hidden in her family and friends’ hearts during the unconstrained Dream Festival?
target: Num ita sit, ut magis timeat malitiam in cordibus familiae atque amicorum latentem in Festo Somniorum intemerato percipiendi?

source: She’d rather gallivant outside and see others’ dark sides than experience that herself?
target: Malit foras vagari et obscuras aliorum facies videre, quam id ipsa experiri.

source: Lumian could understand Amandina’s rationale.
target: Lumian rationem Amandinae intellexit.

source: He dropped the subject and turned to the silent Robert.
target: Rem reliquit et ad silentem Robertum se convertit.

source: “How different is your spirit channeling during the Dream Festival from usual? Will those spirits become more violent and difficult to communicate with?”
target: “Quantum differt transmissio spirituum tua in Festo Somniorum ab illa solita? Eosne spiritus magis violenti atque difficiliores ad colloquendum fient?”

source: Robert, now in a white shirt and black pants, was silent for a few seconds before saying, “It’s no different.”
target: Robert, nunc in camisia alba et braccis nigris indutus, paucis momentis silentium tulit antequam dixit: “Non differt.”

source: Could the excessive emotions and desires of the special dream exclusively target living creatures, leaving spirits unaffected by their typical lack of self‑control?
target: Num affectus atque cupiditates excessivae huius specialis somnii solum creaturas vivas intingant, et spiritus, solito carentes moderationis, intacti maneant?

source: Or is the spirit world and its denizens fake—part of the dream aligning with Robert’s imagination?
target: An mundus spirituum et incolae eius ficti sunt—pars somnii, imaginationi Roberti conformata?

source: It’s likely the latter possibility.
target: Probabiliter ultima possibilitas est.

source: Spirit Mediums don’t just connect with local spirits to borrow power.
target: Medium spirituum non solum cum spiritibus localibus communicant ad potestatem mutuandam.

source: Robert didn’t say some channeling was impossible in the dream… As Lumian’s thoughts raced, he made a speculation.
target: Robert non affirmavit aliquam conductionem in somnio impossibilem esse… Dum celeriter Luminum cogitationes convergebantur, speculationem fecit.

source: Lumian led Camus and the others through the intersection, quickly returning to Twanaku’s house.
target: Lumian Camum et ceteros per crucem viarum duxit, celeriter ad domum Twanaku redeunte.

source: He had asked about spirit channeling because it closely related to what he planned to do.
target: Rogaverat de conductione spirituum, quia ad id quod facere cogitabat arcte pertinebat.

source: Standing on the second floor of Hisoka’s house, Lumian said to the cold and slightly effeminate Robert, “Have you ever completed a spirit channeling here?”
target: In secundo tabulato domus Hisoka stans, Lumian ad Robertum frigidum et paululum effeminatum dixit: “Numquamne hic conductionem spirituum perfecisti?”

source: “I’ve tried. I can establish connections with surrounding spirits, but there’s nothing special about it,” Robert replied honestly.
target: “Conatus sum. Connexiones cum spiritibus circumstantiis instituere possum, sed nihil speciale illud habet,” respondit Robert sincero animo.

source: Amandina chimed in, “He tried it in reality, in the dream, and during the Dream Festival.
target: Amandina addidit: “Id in re, in somnio, atque in Festo Somniorum temptavit.

source: “We’re all curious about this place’s uniqueness and want to figure out the reason, but those spirits don’t know anything about it.”
target: Omnes nos singularitate huius loci curiosi sumus et rationem detegere volumus, sed illi spiritus nihil de eo sciunt.”

source: Lumian nodded, took out his golden pocket watch, glanced at it, and said, “Come up to me in two minutes and help me with a designated spirit channeling. All of you can come up.”
target: Lumian annuit, deponens aureum horologium portatile, eum intuebatur, et dixit: “Ascende ad me intra duo minuta et adiuva me in conductione spirituum designata. Omnes vos ad me ascendere potestis.”

source: Robert breathed a relieved sigh, realizing he wouldn’t face this alone.
target: Robert levitate suspiravit, intellegens se hoc non solum subiturum esse.

source: On the third floor, in Hisoka’s bedroom, Lumian spread his arms and performed the Dancer’s Summoning Dance once more.
target: In tertio tabulato, in cubiculo Hisoka, Lumian brachia patefecit et iterum Saltationem Evocatricem Saltatoris egit.

source: Previously, using the Mystery Prying Glasses in the real world, he realized this place had a mysterious connection to the black boulder.
target: Prius, utens speculis arcani explorandi in mundo reali, animadvertit hunc locum mysticam coniunctionem habere cum saxo nigro.

source: Just now, Padre Cali had mentioned that the black boulder was actually an ancient tomb—the source of his, Robert’s, Amandina’s, and even “Hisoka” Twanaku’s superpowers, as well as the Dream Festival itself.
target: Modo, Padre Cali commemoravit saxum nigrum revera sepulcrum antiquum esse—fons potentiarum mearum, Roberti, Amandinae, atque etiam “Hisoka” Twanaku, simulque ipse Festum Somniorum.

source: In that case, performing the Summoning Dance in Hisoka’s house might attract special, strange items connected to the black ancient tomb.
target: Quoque igitur, Saltationem Evocatricem in domo Hisoka peragendo, specialia et mirabilia, quae ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum pertineant, allicere potest.

source: Perhaps he could obtain important information about the tomb or the corpse inside.
target: Fortasse notitiam magni momenti de sepulcro aut cadavere intus obtinere poterit.

source: It was much safer than using the Mystery Prying Glasses or dancing after reaching the tomb.
target: Multo tutius erat quam utens speculis arcani explorandi aut saltatione post sepulcrum pertingendo.

source: Furthermore, Lumian had no intention of directly attaching any summoned entity to himself.
target: Praeterea, Lumian non intendebat ullam entitatem evocatam directe sibi affigere.

source: He had enlisted Robert’s help to ensure safer, more effective spirit channeling.
target: Ad conductionem spirituum tutiorem et efficaciorem perficiendam, auxilium Roberti obtinuit.

source: A Spirit Medium could communicate with surrounding spirits or through specific directions and descriptions.
target: Medium spirituum cum spiritibus circumstantiis aut per certas instructiones et descriptiones communicare poterat.

source: However, they couldn’t rely on the Summoning Dance and a location’s uniqueness to attract more distant, hidden spirits like a Dancer could.
target: Tamen in Saltatione Evocatoria et singularitate loci confidere non poterant, ut saltator spiritus remotiores et occultos allicere posset.

source: A Spirit Medium could borrow spirits’ power to achieve supernatural effects and communicate with them in detail.
target: Medium spirituum potentiam mutuo sumere poterat ad effectus supernaturales efficiendos et cum illis in singulari modo communicare.

source: A Dancer could choose to obtain a trait, ability, or limited memory fragment.
target: Saltator eligere poterat ut aliquam indolem, facultatem, aut memoriam finitam obtineret.

source: Amidst Lumian’s contorted, sonorous, bizarre dance, his spirituality combined with the environment’s unique power, spreading in all directions.
target: In medio saltationis contortae, sonorae, et mirabilis Luminum, spiritualitas eius cum singulari potentia ambientis commissa est, in omnes partes diffundens.

source: As the intense dance neared its climax, something finally emerged from underground and condensed on the glass‑enclosed window.
target: Cum saltatio intensa ad apicem accedebat, aliquid tandem ex subterraneo emersit et in fenestra vitrea inclusa condensatum apparuit.

source: A human‑like shadow wore a black robe, strikingly resembling the tomb keeper Lumian encountered at the dream’s edge, yet with differences.
target: Umbra humano similis, veste nigra induta, prodigiose sepulcri custos, quem Luminum in limine somnii convenit, similis apparuit, attamen cum nonnullis differentibus.

source: The hooded face seemed fixated on Lumian, eager yet sensing The Fool’s seal and the Blood Emperor’s residual aura, not daring to truly possess him.
target: Vultus cucullatus in Luminum adfixus videbatur, cupidus tamen, Sigillum Stulti atque remanentem aurem Sanguinis Imperatoris sentiens, nec ausus vere eum possidere.

source: Lumian didn’t force orders. He continued the Summoning Dance until Robert and the others arrived, then slowed to a halt.
target: Lumian mandata non coegit. Saltationem Evocatricem persequebatur usque dum Robertus et ceteri advenissent, deinde paulatim cessavit.

source: During this, he pointed at the black‑robed figure and told Robert, “Hurry up and communicate with it.”
target: Interea, indicans personam veste nigra indutam, Roberto dixit: “Festina et cum ea comunica!”

source: Robert nodded slightly, retrieving a bottle of Full Moon Essence Oil from his pocket.
target: Robert leviter annuit, et laguncam Olei Esentiae Lunae Plenilunii ex sinu suo extraxit.
